title: kate-core: unindent the other indent style
summary: Unindent removes one tab when spaces are configured and the line starts with a tab. It removes spaces when tabs are configured and the line starts with spaces. The configured unit still wins when the line starts with that unit. This packet does not bind a key. It does not add a dependency. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: If the line starts with indent_unit, delete that unit. Otherwise delete the other style. Spaces mode and a leading tab deletes one tab. Tab mode and leading spaces deletes up to indent_width spaces. A width of 0 counts as 1. A shorter space run is deleted in full. One step does not delete a tab and spaces together. Do not change newline_insertion. Do not edit workspace.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: indent::tests::spaces_mode_strips_one_tab
regression_tests.asserts: With indent_with_spaces true, unindent of a line that starts with one tab deletes that tab. A line that starts with four spaces still loses those four spaces.

regression_tests.name: indent::tests::tab_mode_strips_leading_spaces
regression_tests.asserts: With indent_with_spaces false and indent_width 4, unindent deletes four leading spaces. Two leading spaces are deleted in full. A leading tab is still deleted.
